exposure: gestational age at diagnosis (<30 weeks, >=30 weeks)
cohort: 40 women with gestational breast cancer in Australia and New Zealand between 2013 and 2014.
finding: Gestational breast cancer diagnosed before 30 weeks' gestation was associated with surgical and systemic cancer care during pregnancy and planned preterm birth, while cancer treatment was deferred to postdelivery for women diagnosed from 30 weeks.
